cards.back:
Very old, from a long time ago. Opposite: modern.
Bahasa Indonesia: kuno
Example: The ancient temple was built over a thousand years ago.
cards.say: ancient. The ancient temple was built over a thousand years ago.

cards.back:
Of the present time, new in style. Opposite: ancient.
Bahasa Indonesia: modern
Example: The modern library has fast computers and bright rooms.
cards.say: modern. The modern library has fast computers and bright rooms.

cards.back:
Winning a game, race or battle. Opposite: defeat.
Bahasa Indonesia: kemenangan
Example: The team celebrated its victory with a cup of juice.
cards.say: victory. The team celebrated its victory with a cup of juice.

cards.back:
Losing a game, race or battle. Opposite: victory.
Bahasa Indonesia: kekalahan
Example: After the defeat, the players practised even harder.
cards.say: defeat. After the defeat, the players practised even harder.

cards.back:
Happy to give more than is needed. Opposite: greedy.
Bahasa Indonesia: dermawan
Example: A generous neighbour gave us a basket of mangoes.
cards.say: generous. A generous neighbour gave us a basket of mangoes.

cards.back:
Wanting much more than you need. Opposite: generous.
Bahasa Indonesia: serakah
Example: The greedy crow tried to carry too many nuts at once.
cards.say: greedy. The greedy crow tried to carry too many nuts at once.

cards.back:
To become bigger. Opposite: shrink.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengembang, memperluas
Example: A balloon will expand as you blow air into it.
cards.say: expand. A balloon will expand as you blow air into it.

cards.back:
To become smaller. Opposite: expand.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyusut
Example: The wool jumper will shrink if you wash it in hot water.
cards.say: shrink. The wool jumper will shrink if you wash it in hot water.

cards.back:
To take something that is offered. Opposite: refuse.
Bahasa Indonesia: menerima
Example: I will accept the invitation to your birthday party.
cards.say: accept. I will accept the invitation to your birthday party.

cards.back:
To say no to something that is offered. Opposite: accept.
Bahasa Indonesia: menolak
Example: He had to refuse the sweets because he was ill.
cards.say: refuse. He had to refuse the sweets because he was ill.

cards.back:
To have something as a part. Opposite: exclude.
Bahasa Indonesia: mencakup
Example: The price will include lunch and a bus ticket.
cards.say: include. The price will include lunch and a bus ticket.

cards.back:
To leave something out. Opposite: include.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengecualikan
Example: The list will exclude children who are under five.
cards.say: exclude. The list will exclude children who are under five.

cards.back:
Lasting for a very long time or for always. Opposite: temporary.
Bahasa Indonesia: tetap
Example: The ink made a permanent mark on the white shirt.
cards.say: permanent. The ink made a permanent mark on the white shirt.

cards.back:
Lasting for only a short time. Opposite: permanent.
Bahasa Indonesia: sementara
Example: A temporary bridge was built while the old one was repaired.
cards.say: temporary. A temporary bridge was built while the old one was repaired.

cards.back:
To go up. Opposite: descend.
Bahasa Indonesia: naik
Example: The balloon began to ascend slowly into the sky.
cards.say: ascend. The balloon began to ascend slowly into the sky.

cards.back:
To go down. Opposite: ascend.
Bahasa Indonesia: turun
Example: The plane will descend as it gets closer to the airport.
cards.say: descend. The plane will descend as it gets closer to the airport.

cards.back:
Not smooth, with a bumpy surface. Opposite: smooth.
Bahasa Indonesia: kasar
Example: The path was rough and covered with sharp stones.
cards.say: rough. The path was rough and covered with sharp stones.

cards.back:
Having a surface with no bumps. Opposite: rough.
Bahasa Indonesia: halus
Example: The smooth stone felt cool in my hand.
cards.say: smooth. The smooth stone felt cool in my hand.

cards.back:
Easily broken. Opposite: sturdy.
Bahasa Indonesia: rapuh
Example: The fragile vase must be carried with both hands.
cards.say: fragile. The fragile vase must be carried with both hands.

cards.back:
Strong and not easily broken. Opposite: fragile.
Bahasa Indonesia: kokoh
Example: A sturdy table held all the heavy books.
cards.say: sturdy. A sturdy table held all the heavy books.

cards.back:
To reach a place. Opposite: depart.
Bahasa Indonesia: tiba
Example: The train will arrive at platform two in five minutes.
cards.say: arrive. The train will arrive at platform two in five minutes.

cards.back:
To leave a place. Opposite: arrive.
Bahasa Indonesia: berangkat
Example: The bus will depart at half past seven.
cards.say: depart. The bus will depart at half past seven.
